parts.name: Eyepiece
parts.body: A 10× ocular acts as a magnifier for the real image formed by the objective. Its field stop defines the visible circular field.

parts.name: Optical head & body tube
parts.body: The rigid body holds the optical spacing. A prism folds the path into the inclined viewing tube; the objective forms an inverted real image near the ocular field lens.
parts.chain: Arm → head mount → folded body tube → ocular

parts.name: Objective lenses & nosepiece
parts.body: The objective collects light transmitted by the specimen and forms a real, inverted image. The revolving nosepiece brings a different objective onto the optical axis.
parts.chain: Specimen → active objective → real intermediate image

parts.name: Specimen slide
parts.role: Place a thin sample in the focal plane
parts.body: The glass slide carries the specimen and its coverslip. Moving the slide right makes its image move left: the objective reverses the image in both lateral directions.

parts.name: Mechanical stage
parts.body: The stage aperture passes transmitted light. The slide holder and X/Y drives move the sample laterally; the focus carriage moves the stage vertically without moving the optical head.
parts.chain: Focus rack → stage carriage → slide holder → specimen

parts.name: Condenser & iris diaphragm
parts.body: The condenser concentrates illumination onto the specimen. Its aperture iris controls the illumination angle: closing it reduces brightness and effective aperture while increasing depth of field.

parts.name: Coarse & fine focus
parts.body: The coarse drive turns a pinion against the stage rack for large movements. The concentric fine control makes much smaller adjustments. Both change the specimen–objective spacing, not magnification.
parts.chain: Focus knob → pinion → rack → stage → focal plane

parts.name: Arm & support frame
parts.role: Hold the optical and mechanical axes
parts.body: The cast frame joins the head to the base and guides the focus carriage. Its stiffness keeps the objective centered over the specimen as the stage travels.
parts.chain: Base → rigid arm → head + focus bearings

parts.name: Base & illuminator
parts.body: A weighted base supports the instrument. The LED and collector direct light upward into the condenser; the intensity control changes illumination without changing magnification.
